description: This file contains unit tests for the AuditableInterceptor class in the OpenMRS project. It tests behavior related to persistence lifecycle callbacks such as onFlushDirty and onSave, particularly regarding auditing fields like changedBy, dateChanged, creator, dateCreated, and person-specific audit fields. The tests ensure that the interceptor correctly updates audit fields for different objects and that the registration on the session functions as expected.

classes.name: AuditableInterceptorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AuditableInterceptor, verifying audit fields are correctly set during entity updates and inserts, and ensuring proper interceptor registration.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldReturnFalseForNonAuditableObjects
methods.description: Tests that onFlushDirty returns false when the object does not implement Auditable.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldSetTheChangedByField
methods.description: Verifies that onFlushDirty sets the 'changedBy' field for an Auditable User object.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldSetTheDateChangedField
methods.description: Verifies that onFlushDirty sets the 'dateChanged' field for an Auditable User object.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldAddPersonChangedByForPerson
methods.description: Ensures onFlushDirty adds 'personChangedBy' for Person objects.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldAddPersonDateChangedForPerson
methods.description: Ensures onFlushDirty adds 'personDateChanged' for Person objects.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldNotFailWithNullPreviousState
methods.description: Ensures onFlushDirty does not throw exception if previousState is null.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldBeCalledWhenSavingAnAuditable
methods.description: Checks that the interceptor's onFlushDirty is invoked during session flush when updating User objects.

methods.name: onFlushDirty_shouldNotFailWhenTheDaemonUserModifiesSomething
methods.description: Ensures that audit update does not fail when modifications are made by scheduled daemon tasks.

methods.name: AsDaemonTask
methods.description: Inner class to execute a task as a daemon scheduled task.

methods.name: onSave_shouldReturnTrueIfDateCreatedWasNull
methods.description: Verifies that onSave returns true when 'dateCreated' is null.

methods.name: onSave_shouldReturnTrueIfCreatorWasNull
methods.description: Verifies that onSave returns true when 'creator' is null.

methods.name: onSave_shouldReturnFalseIfDateCreatedAndCreatorWasNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that onSave returns false when both 'creator' and 'dateCreated' are set.

methods.name: onSave_shouldBeCalledWhenSavingOpenmrsObject
methods.description: Tests that creating a new User triggers onSave and properly populates audit fields.

methods.name: onSave_shouldPopulateDateCreatedForPersonIfNull
methods.description: Checks that saving a Person with null dateCreated populates it.

methods.name: onSave_shouldPopulateCreatorForPersonIfNull
methods.description: Checks that saving a Person with null creator populates it.

methods.name: onSave_shouldPopulatePersonChangedByandPersonDateChangedIfPersonAlreadyExists
methods.description: Ensures that saving an existing Person updates 'personChangedBy' and 'personDateChanged' fields.

methods.name: createPersonWithNameAndAddress
methods.description: Helper method to create a Person with name and address set.
